name: Quantum Phase Equivalence Disguise
description: Replaces the linear constraint $x_u - x_v = 0$ with the quantum transition probability constraint $|\langle \psi_u | \psi_v \rangle|^2 = 1$. This forces the model to deduce that perfect fidelity implies collinearity up to a global phase, which acts as an equivalence relation, thereby mapping the problem to finding a minimum-cost connected subgraph (Steiner Tree) without using any graph or network terminology.
